fusions.name: Warren Bolt
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 7 tiles to the target first, then strikes for 12 damage, up to 1.8 times as much at maximum range.

fusions.name: Thumper Nip
fusions.desc: Throws a quick nip that deals 4 damage. For 3 seconds after using it, you move 15% faster.

fusions.name: Bolt Hole
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Always Ready
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 15%.
